title: Decision-point counting
responsibility: Counts the supported code and Svelte template decision markers used for complexity measurements.

inputs.name: blockComplexity.masked
inputs.description: Source with comments and string contents already masked; matching keywords and operators are counted textually.

inputs.name: blockComplexity.base
inputs.description: Initial count: 1 for a function, or 0 when no function base is needed.

inputs.name: templateComplexity.markup
inputs.description: Markup to scan for Svelte if, each and await blocks and else-if branches.

outputs.name: blockComplexity
outputs.description: Base plus occurrences of if, for, while, case, catch, logical-and, logical-or, nullish-coalescing and recognized conditional question marks.

outputs.name: templateComplexity
outputs.description: Number of recognized Svelte block and else-if decision markers, or zero when there are none.
